_comment: Fill these in, then run ./fill-placeholders.sh. Blank values are fine — any block marked data-needs simply disappears from the page rather than showing a placeholder, so the site stays publishable while details are outstanding. YOUR-DOMAIN takes the full host, no https:// and no trailing slash.
_prefilled: YOUR-DOMAIN and DATE are set to the current live address and today's date. Change YOUR-DOMAIN when a proper domain is bought.
_optional: Blank = the block is removed from the page. Add them whenever Sam sends them.
_required: REGULATORY. The site should not go live until these four are filled — fill-placeholders.sh will keep telling you so.
